applicabilityBasis.summary: sBOLD is an ERC-4626 share representing a proportional claim on BOLD allocated to Liquity V2 Stability Pools. Interest and liquidation gains change the BOLD-per-share exchange rate. Redemption delivers a variable quantity of BOLD, a digital asset, without an issuer obligation to pay a fixed amount of national currency. These rights fall outside the payment-stablecoin definition in GENIUS section 2(22).

genius.notes: This assessment covers the third-party K3 sBOLD vault share, not the underlying BOLD stablecoin. Liquity confirms that K3 builds and maintains the vault and that the Liquity core team does not. The K3 protocol documents identify an actively managed Stability Pool position with reinvested returns and variable redemption proceeds. No legal token-issuer entity is established by these documents, so issuerEntity is omitted rather than using a brand or the unrelated K3 Capital Group corporate entity. K3's U.S. website says no services are currently offered to U.S. residents through that site; this site-level statement is not treated as a universal token-holding prohibition. No payment-stablecoin issuer authorization is asserted.
